title: Train coming
checked: Every reachable state checked (7 states, 15 with their data, 17 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 7 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: The barrier is never up with a train on the crossing
rules.says: While a train is on the crossing, or another is still due, the barrier stays down.
rules.path: Take away the crossing clear guard and it breaks in 8 steps: train detected, wait 6 s, lower barrier, barrier down, another train, train arrives, train leaves, raise barrier.

rules.rule: The lights flash before the barrier moves
rules.says: The barrier starts down only after the lights have flashed for six seconds.
rules.path: Take away the lights flashed guard and it breaks in 2 steps: train detected, lower barrier.
